# Ace Hardware

> Ace Hardware is a retailer-owned hardware cooperative with more than 5,000 locally owned and operated stores across all 50 U.S. states and 70+ countries. Stores stock paint, tools, lawn and garden equipment, plumbing and electrical supplies, grills, outdoor living, and seasonal goods, and are known for in-store services like paint matching, key cutting, propane exchange, and small-engine repair. Most stores are independently owned, so inventory, services, and hours vary by location — the Store Locator is the authoritative source for what a specific store carries and offers.

## About

- [About Ace Hardware](https://www.acehardware.com/about-us ): Cooperative model, history (founded 1924), and "The Helpful Place" brand positioning.
- [Community Involvement](https://www.acehardware.com/community-involvement ): Children's Miracle Network partnership and local store giving programs.
- [Careers](https://careers.acehardware.com/ ): Corporate and store-level roles; store hiring is handled by individual owners.

## Stores & Services

- [Store Locator](https://www.acehardware.com/store-locator ): Find local Ace stores by ZIP code; canonical source for store-specific hours, inventory, and services.
- [Propane Refill & Exchange Locator](https://www.acehardware.com/store-locator?service=Propane%20Refill%20or%20Exchange ): Stores offering propane tank refill or exchange.
- [The Paint Studio](https://www.acehardware.com/thepaintstudio ): In-store paint matching and color consultation; carries Benjamin Moore, Clark+Kensington, Magnolia Home, Royal, and Valspar.
- [Customer Service Hub](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service ): Index of policies and store-services pages (returns, delivery, assembly, haul-away, recalls).
- [Free Store Pickup](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=free-store-pickup-curbside ): Order online, pick up in-store; curbside available at participating stores.
- [Delivery From Store](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=delivery-from-store ): Same-day local delivery from a nearby Ace.
- [Assembly Information](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=assembly-information ): Free in-store assembly on grills, mowers, and select large items.
- [30-Day Return Policy](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=30-day-return-policy ): Standard return window and exclusions.

## Membership & Programs

- [Ace Rewards](https://www.acehardware.com/ace-rewards ): Free loyalty program with points on purchases, member coupons, and birthday rewards. (Highest-linked page on the site.)
- [Ace Trade Credit](https://www.acehardware.com/ace-trade-credit ): Net-30 commercial account for trade pros and businesses.
- [Ace for Business (B2B)](https://www.acehardware.com/b2b-home ): Bulk purchasing, multi-user accounts, and trade pricing.
- [Local Ad](https://www.acehardware.com/local-ad ): Current weekly circular for the user's local store.
- [Sales & Specials](https://www.acehardware.com/best-sales-and-specials ): Site-wide promotions and clearance.
- [Helpful Finds](https://www.acehardware.com/helpful-finds ): Editor-curated product picks across categories.

## Departments

Top-level category landing pages — Ace's full assortment is organized under these eleven departments.

- [Tools](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/tools ): Power tools, hand tools, accessories, storage, and workwear. Strongest in DEWALT, Milwaukee, CRAFTSMAN, DIABLO.
- [Lawn and Garden](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/lawn-and-garden ): Mowers, trimmers, gardening tools, watering, fertilizer, outdoor power equipment. Strongest in STIHL, EGO, Scotts, Roundup.
- [Paint and Supplies](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/paint-and-supplies ): Interior/exterior paint, primer, stain, painting tools. Brand partners: Benjamin Moore, Clark+Kensington, Magnolia Home, Valspar.
- [Hardware](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/hardware ): Fasteners, fire safety, locks, chain, and rope.
- [Plumbing](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/plumbing ): Fittings, fixtures, water heaters, drain care.
- [Lighting and Electrical](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/lighting-and-electrical ): Bulbs, fixtures, smart home, wiring; brand depth in Feit.
- [Heating and Cooling](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/heating-and-cooling ): Heaters, air conditioners, fans, thermostats.
- [Home and Decor](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/home-and-decor ): Cleaning, small appliances, kitchen, apparel, canning.
- [Outdoor Living](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/outdoor-living ): Grills and smokers (Weber, Traeger, Big Green Egg), patio furniture, coolers (YETI), pond supplies, sporting goods.
- [Building Supplies](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/building-supplies ): Lumber, drywall, ladders, insulation.
- [Automotive, RV and Marine](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/automotive-rv-and-marine ): Auto care, batteries, fluids, RV/marine accessories.

## Featured Brand Hubs

LLM responses already strongly associate Ace with these brands; these are the canonical brand landing pages on acehardware.com.

- [Shop by Brand (index)](https://www.acehardware.com/brands )
- [STIHL at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/lawn-and-garden/stihl ): Outdoor power equipment; Ace is a major STIHL servicing dealer.
- [Traeger at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/outdoor-living/traeger ): Pellet grills; Ace assembles and delivers free.
- [Weber at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/outdoor-living/weber ): Gas, charcoal, and pellet grills.
- [Big Green Egg at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/biggreenegg ): Authorized dealer for kamado grills and accessories.
- [YETI at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/outdoor-living/yeti ): Coolers, drinkware, and bags.
- [DEWALT at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/tools/dewalt ): Cordless and corded power tools.
- [Milwaukee at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/tools/milwaukee ): M12 / M18 cordless platforms.
- [CRAFTSMAN at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/tools/craftsman ): Hand tools, mechanic's sets, storage.
- [DIABLO at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/tools/diablo ): Saw blades and cutting accessories.
- [EGO at Ace](https://www.acehardware.com/departments/lawn-and-garden/ego ): Battery-powered outdoor equipment.

## Tips & Advice

- [Tips & Advice Hub](https://www.acehardware.com/tips/ ): Editorial how-to articles, project guides, and seasonal advice covering paint, lawn and garden, grilling, home improvement, and small repairs. Canonical answer source for "how do I..." questions about Ace product categories.

## Optional

- [Newsroom (corporate)](https://newsroom.acehardware.com/ ): Press releases, executive announcements, and corporate financials. Subdomain.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.acehardware.com/gift-cards ): Physical and digital gift cards.
- [Contact Us](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=contact-us ): General customer-care contact form.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=privacy-policy )
- [Terms of Use](https://www.acehardware.com/customer-service?page=terms-of-use )
